fusions.name: Hobnailed Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks an enemy with an iron-shod boot, dealing 12 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, knocking it 3 tiles back and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Road's Last Mile
fusions.desc: Brings the whole road behind you down in one stamp, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for each stretch you have travelled, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, you take 20% less damage, move 20% faster, and are freed of every root, freeze and slow.

fusions.name: Mile-Hardened
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently 8% higher, and you have 8% physical resistance.
